original_description: Create App Store and Google Play screenshots for your app. Describe what the app does and AppScreenshotStudio designs a full set of store screenshots at the exact sizes Apple and Google require. Refine the set by describing the change: shorter headlines, a new colour palette, a different layout, a tilted device, or one background stretched across several screenshots. When it looks right, export the PNGs, ready to upload to App Store Connect or Google Play Console.
summary_ja: アプリストア掲載用のスクリーンショットを作り、レイアウトなどを調整する。
limitations: ストアが要求するサイズへの対応は提供元の説明であり、実際の要件や出力は未確認。
